scheme_name: GIFT City Financial Services Startup Support
overview: GIFT City Financial Services Startup Support is a program designed to foster innovation and growth in the financial technology and banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI) sectors by providing startups with access to GIFT City's infrastructure, regulatory sandbox, and ecosystem benefits. The scheme aims to attract and nurture FinTech startups by offering them a conducive environment for development, testing, and scaling of financial products and services within India's first international financial services centre.
objectives: Promote innovation in financial technology and services
Provide startups with access to GIFT City's world-class infrastructure
Enable testing of financial products in a regulated sandbox environment
Facilitate mentorship, networking, and collaboration with industry experts
Support regulatory compliance and approvals for FinTech innovations
Attract domestic and international FinTech ventures to operate from GIFT City
eligibility: Startups operating in the financial technology (FinTech), banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI) sectors that are incorporated as private limited companies, LLPs, or partnerships and are working on innovative financial products, services, or processes. Preference may be given to entities seeking to leverage GIFT City's regulatory sandbox or international financial services platform.
benefits: Access to GIFT City's plug-and-play infrastructure, high-speed connectivity, and 24x7 operational support; eligibility to apply for the IBBI-regulated regulatory sandbox; facilitation in obtaining necessary approvals from financial regulators; networking opportunities with banks, financial institutions, and investors; tax benefits under the Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Act; and support for international business setup and operations.
financial_support: The scheme does not provide direct financial grants or subsidies. Instead, support is primarily non-financial, focusing on infrastructure access, regulatory facilitation, and ecosystem enablement. Startups may benefit indirectly through reduced operational costs, tax incentives under SEZ provisions, and access to funding networks within GIFT City.
application_process: 1. Visit the official GIFT City website or contact the GIFT City Council for startup engagement. 2. Submit an expression of interest detailing the startup’s FinTech/BFSI innovation and business model. 3. Undergo preliminary evaluation by GIFT City authorities. 4. If shortlisted, present the proposal to the relevant committee for approval. 5. Upon approval, complete registration formalities and allocate workspace allotment process. 6. Begin operations and access available support services including sandbox application if applicable.
required_documents: Business plan or pitch deck detailing the FinTech/BFSI innovation
Any existing regulatory approvals or sandbox applications (if applicable)
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year based on availability and evaluation cycles.
implementing_agency: GIFT City Council (GCC), under the aegis of the Government of Gujarat and Government of India
caveats: Access to the regulatory sandbox requires separate application and approval from the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA)
Tax benefits are subject to compliance with SEZ and Income Tax Act provisions
Physical office space allotment is subject to availability and adherence to GIFT City norms
Continued support is contingent on compliance with GIFT City operational and reporting requirements
